title: Hearing on NYC public libraries' research collections
summary: The Council's Committee on Cultural Affairs, Libraries and International Relations held an oversight hearing examining the research and reference collections of the New York Public Library, Brooklyn Public Library and Queens Public Library. Topics included special collections like the Schomburg Center, Center for Brooklyn History and the Woodson and Baker collections, and the costs and value of preserving them. The committee also heard several related resolutions on debt relief and Puerto Rico matters at the same session.
